remarks: Enjoy all Greenwich has to offer with this end unit condo conveniently located close to the Metro-North station, Greenwich Ave, and I95. 3 floors of space to spread out and relax. Main level has a wood-burning fireplace, dining area, kitchen with ss appliances, and large windows with plenty of natural light. Includes a private patio. Upper level provides a large primary bedroom with plenty of closet space and a full bath with tub and stall shower. 2nd bedroom has plenty of closet space and its own full bath. Pull down attic for more storage space. Lower level has laundry, plus another room which can be used as office or storage.
